day_shape: 33 items: Iran FM spokesman Bagheri holds press conference demanding end to war and Hormuz/asset relief from US, Iran executes Erfan Shakourzadeh on CIA/Mossad spying charges, IDF reservist killed by Hezbollah drone, fresh OFAC SDN designation, Times of Israel reports secret Israeli base in Iraqi desert.

threads.label: Bagheri press conference: demands to US
threads.summary: Foreign Ministry spokesman Ismail Bagheri held a press conference setting out Iran's demands to Washington: end of war, lifting of the blockade, cessation of 'maritime piracy' against Iranian ships, and release of frozen assets. Bagheri also responded to Putin's remarks on transferring Iran's uranium reserves, saying the current focus is on ending the war, and stated Iran has not yet 'settled accounts' with aggressors.

threads.label: Execution of Shakourzadeh on espionage charges
threads.summary: Iran executed Erfan Shakourzadeh after conviction for sharing classified scientific information with US and Israeli intelligence services, according to Mizan and Jerusalem Post reports. Iran International cited rights groups warning of a sharp rise in executions on political charges; Defa Press said the accused had worked in the satellite field.

threads.label: Hezbollah drone activity on northern front
threads.summary: Times of Israel reported an IDF reservist was killed by a Hezbollah explosive drone in northern Israel, with IRIB claiming a Hezbollah drone struck an Israeli army surveillance camera. Jerusalem Post carried an analysis piece on the Hezbollah FPV drone threat and potential Israel-Ukraine cooperation.

threads.label: Post-war domestic reconstruction messaging
threads.summary: Regime channels carried recovery and morale items: Tehran's Deputy for Urban Planning said repairs on damaged units would be complete by June, with 39,000 minor-damage plots resolved. Defa Press flagged 7,000 female relief workers deployed in the 'third imposed war', a 2-billion-toman wedding-ring donation campaign, and 8,000 welfare housing units for war-affected residents.

threads.label: Israeli-Iraq base report and US sanctions
threads.summary: Times of Israel reported Israel set up a secret military base in the Iraqi desert in February to support its aerial campaign against Iran, with Bagheri telling reporters Iran would raise the matter with Iraqi parties. OFAC published a fresh Notice of Sanctions Action adding persons and vessels to the SDN List.

The first drone caused a fire in the engine room and the second drone caused a fire in the rear section of the ship.

events.summary_en: CIA and Mossad spy executed in Iran. Erfan Shokourzadeh, son of Jafar, has been hanged for collaborating with the American intelligence service and Mossad, the Israeli spy service. Based on the contents of the file, the accused was recruited as a project by one of the country's scientific organisations operating in the satellite field, given his expertise. The convict, while collaborating with an important scientific body of the country, contacted enemy intelligence services including the CIA and particularly the Mossad terrorist-intelligence service. The accused made contact with enemy intelligence services in three stages, the first and third stages relating to Mossad and the second stage relating to the CIA.

events.title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
events.summary: The U.S. Department of the Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) is publishing the names of one or more persons and vessels that have been placed on OFAC's Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List (SDN List) based on OFAC's determination that one or more applicable legal criteria were satisfied. All property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction of these persons are blocked, and U.S. persons are generally prohibited from engaging in transactions with them. The vessels placed on the SDN List have been identified as property in which a blocked person has an interest.
